implementation.targetScope: Lazy, cached Docker evidence from the marker file, cgroup and mountinfo; current ESM and legacy CommonJS API plus silent CLI exit statuses. No package dependencies.

differences: Adds a CommonJS callable/default bridge and original-name CLI alias for installed open 8.4.2 and is-wsl 2.2.0 callers.
Mountinfo detection matches 4.0.0 and deliberately extends the app's 2.2.1 detection for cgroup v2.
A missing /.dockerenv uses nonthrowing stat; permission and other filesystem failures still fall through.
No Podman/general-container guarantee, Docker daemon query, refresh API or filesystem mutation. Detection is heuristic and must not be used as a security boundary.
Platform caller behavior is simulated; native Windows/WSL/Docker execution, public release and application adoption are not claimed.
